A friend of mine is recruiting a *German* speaking Program Manager. You can contact her directly, if relevant:

Hi everyone 👋

I'm recruiting for a Program Manager position at a global public company traded on NASDAQ and operating in the IoT industry. I'm looking for German-speaking candidates and would greatly appreciate referrals and connections.

🔹 Program Manager role working with international customers

🔹 Fluent German (spoken and written) is required

🔹 Hybrid position – 1 day working from home and 4 days from our offices at Rothschild 3, Tel Aviv

🔹 Reporting directly to the Director of Customer Success Management (CSM)

🔹 Opportunity to work with global customers, complex projects, and multiple stakeholders in a dynamic international environment

I would appreciate any referrals or introductions to relevant candidates.

📩 Contact: mor@barki.org

Thank you! 🙏
